text:
ci-bot: main pipeline on branch main is red after merge. failed job: smoke-gpu (matrix: cuda11, p100). merge commit 622f3a7 by @tayla. logs: https://ci.example/622f3a7/log
alex: pinging infra — who owns smoke-gpu? can someone grab first responder?
maria: I can take a look. pulling logs now. quick grep shows OOM:
```\nRuntimeError: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 1.2 GiB (GPU 0; 11.17 GiB total capacity; 9.95 GiB already allocated)\n  File \"/app/runtime/serve.py\", line 412, in forward\n    out = model.forward(input)\n```\n
sam: hmm, commit touched batching defaults? PR #842 bumped default batch size from 16->32 in runtime config. that would explain OOM. @tayla did that land on main?
tayla: yeah that was my change — I increased default batch for throughput tests. I thought smoke matrix would pin batch to 16 but maybe missed. I'm available to revert.
june: can we rerun the job with forced env override before revert? `cictl rerun --job smoke-gpu --env BATCH_SIZE=16` — I'll kick it.
alex: rerun queued (https://ci.example/runs/622f3a7-rerun-1). ETA ~3m.
ci-bot: rerun started by june (run id 622f3a7-rerun-1)
ci-bot: rerun finished: smoke-gpu PASSED on run 622f3a7-rerun-1 :tada:
maria: good signal — looks like batch is culprit. propose revert or add test guard. @tayla can you open a quick revert PR and we'll run canary?
tayla: will open revert PR now. also thinking we should add a CI matrix entry to exercise higher BATCH_SIZE so we don't regress silently.
sam: agree — revert + follow-up to add explicit matrix entry. For now revert + canary roll.
tayla: PR opened: #849 revert default batch bump. kicking canary run: https://ci.example/runs/622f3a7-canary-849
alex: thanks all — assigning owner: tayla. marking triage resolved for the immediate outage.
